best_section.where: Rear bays along the tree line at the back of the car park, against the railway corridor, roughly 20m north-east of the pin

summary: Tree-screened public car park backing onto the rail corridor, well clear of the nearest houses.
reasons: Screened by trees, backs onto rail corridor
Houses are 60m+ away, across the road

drivers.seclusion: Rear bays are screened from the street by heavy tree canopy and back directly onto the railway corridor; nearest houses are over 60m away across Alderson Street.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed, marked car park with multiple full-size bays and turning room; easy in and out for a 2WD van.
drivers.traffic: Sees daytime use (several cars present in both captures, likely a sports ground or community facility nearby) but sits off the road with no through traffic; should be quiet overnight.
drivers.convention: Other vehicles are routinely parked here, so an overnight van is unlikely to stand out.

flags: Adjacent to an active rail corridor — train noise likely
Daytime use by other cars suggests the lot may not be empty early evening
sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy on the north and east sides shades the rear bays through most of the day; the front bays near the street entrance are more open.
cannot_judge: Whether the car park has a gate that's closed overnight
Street or car park lighting at night
Any on-site signage restricting overnight parking
